capabilities: Compute daily verse portions and cycle length for a chosen Quran part
Create and edit visual memorization mindmaps for surahs
Export mindmaps, verse groups and notes as Anki .apkg decks
Import and export mindmap .zip bundles for sharing
Play reciter audio in listening or reading mode
extras: Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states it is unfinished, expects breaking changes, and says mindmap import will arrive before it is ready for use. Sync is only tested with Resilio Sync.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tools for pacing Quranic verse review or turning memorization maps into spaced-repetition decks.

relations.evidence: The plugin prepares your cards — daily reading, mindmaps, verse groups — and Anki handles all reviews and scheduling.

summary: Quran memorization plugin that paces daily review portions, builds visual mindmaps per surah, and exports Anki decks as .apkg files.
